claim_text: Mouse NK maturation CD27+CD11b- -> CD27+CD11b+ -> CD27-CD11b+

audit.species: mouse (C57BL/6 background throughout; Chiossone used NDE = Ncr1/NKp46-driven DTR-EGFP transgenics. Hayakawa & Smyth 2006 additionally phenotyped human peripheral blood, but that human arm is marker overlap only and carries no developmental ordering.)
audit.what_was_measured: ORIGINAL PRIMARY (Chiossone 2009) — methods NOT readable; from the design statement only, therefore not methods-verified: in mouse (C57BL/6 NDE transgenic, NK-restricted EGFP+DTR), EGFP+ NK cells were FACS-sorted on surface density of CD27 and CD11b and injected into UNIRRADIATED recipients, and donor EGFP+ cells were re-stained for CD27/CD11b by flow cytometry at later timepoints; in parallel diphtheria toxin was injected to transiently ablate NK cells and the CD27/CD11b staining of repopulating EGFP+ NK cells was scored over a time course; the four subsets were additionally compared by whole-genome microarray expression proximity and by proliferation at steady state and during repopulation. Cell doses, timepoints and recipient n are not recoverable from any accessible text. VERIFIED METHODS (Gordon 2012, Immunity, PMC3381976): in mouse, at least 1x10^4 FACS-purified medullary NK-cell subsets (TRAIL+CD27lowCD11blow, TRAIL+CD27highCD11blow, DX5+CD27highCD11blow, DX5+CD27high/lowCD11bhigh; lineage-depleted with anti-CD4/CD5/CD8/CD19/Gr-1/Ter119) were injected into unirradiated Il2rg-/-Rag2-/- recipients; at 1 week post-transfer the indicated organs were harvested and donor cells stained for Eomes, TRAIL, CD27 and CD11b by flow cytometry; data representative of 3 independent experiments. VERIFIED METHODS (Flommersfeld 2021, Immunity, PMC8528403): in mouse, splenic CD3-CD19-NK1.1+Ly49H+CD27+ cells carrying distinct retroviral colour barcodes were index-sorted (CD62L and CD11b indexed), 15-20 single cells per host were transferred i.v. into Rag2-/-Il2rg-/-, Klra8-/- or NKp46iCre x R26-LSL-iDTA recipients, rested 2-3 weeks under homeostatic conditions (or infected with MCMV and analysed d7-10), and clone-level CD27/CD62L/CD11b surface staining was read by flow cytometry.
audit.n: Chiossone 2009 (the original primary): NOT RECOVERABLE — no cell dose, no timepoint, no recipient count obtainable, because the methods are paywalled/Cloudflare-blocked. Gordon 2012 (verified): "3 experiments"; recipient mice per group not stated in the accessible text. Flommersfeld 2021 (verified): 15-20 barcoded single donor cells per recipient mouse across multiple recipients and multiple independent experiments; exact per-panel recipient counts not extracted. Daussy 2014 (verified): female mice 8-24 wk, per-figure animal n not extracted.
audit.n_unit: animals (recipient mice). NOTE: none of the accessible sources reports the claim's ordering with an animal-level n — Gordon 2012 reports only "3 independent experiments", and for the original primary (Chiossone 2009) no n of any unit could be retrieved. The n is NOT cells (cell doses of 1x10^4 / 15-20 single cells are transfer inputs, not replicate n).
audit.controls: Chiossone 2009: the only control-relevant design feature recoverable is that recipients were UNIRRADIATED (avoids the irradiation/lymphopenia artefact that confounds most transfer studies) and that four orthogonal read-outs were combined (DT-depletion repopulation kinetics, microarray expression proximity, proliferation, transfer). No control description, no isotype/congenic-marker detail, and no statistics are verifiable. Gordon 2012 (verified): mature DX5+ subsets transferred in parallel as a phenotypic-stability control ("remained DX5+, Eomes+, and Ly49+"), congenic marking, multiple organs sampled. Flommersfeld 2021 (verified): colour-barcode multiplexing so clones are internally controlled within one host; parallel population transfers; uninfected homeostatic arm as a control for infection-driven phenotype change; an in situ retrogenic-chimera scRNA-seq arm explicitly included because "adoptive transfer may have biased the developmental capacity of the indicated NK cell subsets". MISSING ACROSS ALL SOURCES I could read: no reciprocal transfer of the terminal CD27-CD11b+ subset demonstrating that the reverse transition is blocked; no purity/contamination quantification of the sorted CD27+CD11b- gate reported in any accessible text; no clonal control in the original primary.
audit.strongest_alternative_explanation: The sorted "CD27+CD11b-" gate is not one precursor state but a mixture of lineages with different fates, so a BULK population transfer reads out selective survival/expansion of the cNK-biased fraction as if it were conversion (canonical alternative: a PRE-EXISTING subset is selected/expanded, plus two independent origins). This is not hypothetical — the one study with clonal resolution states it outright. Flommersfeld 2021 (verified, archived text): "we transferred low numbers of Ly49H+ ILC1-like or cNK cells into NKp46iCre x R26-LSL-iDTA or Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- mice and rested the transferred cells under homeostatic conditions for 2 or 3 weeks... Importantly, even without MCMV infection, no evidence for maturation of ILC1-like NK cells into the CD62L+ subsets was found, while CD27+CD62L+ NK cells further matured into CD27-CD62L+ cells." The ILC1-like branch inside the CD27+ gate is KLRG1-, CD11b-, Ly6C-, CD160+, transcriptionally overlapping ILC1 — i.e. it sits squarely in the claim's "CD27+CD11b-" stage and never progresses. Secondary alternatives: (a) CD27 and CD11b are environment/activation-regulated rather than an intrinsic clock — CD11b acquisition is monocyte- and IL-15-dependent (Soderquest 2011 Blood, PMID 21389319), so the "sequence" can be a signalling gradient read as a developmental order; (b) Chiossone's own supporting read-outs are equally consistent with differential proliferation — the paper itself reports that the CD11b-low subsets proliferate more, so faster appearance of later-gate cells after DT depletion is confounded by expansion rate, not conversion; (c) the microarray "global gene profile proximity" between subsets is expression-space adjacency and cannot distinguish "A becomes B" from "A and B are independent adjacent states" (G2 class).
audit.counter_evidence: 1) Flommersfeld S, et al. Immunity 2021;54:2288-2304 — PMID 34437840 / PMC8528403 (full text read, archived /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_PMC8528403.txt). Single-cell colour-barcoded fate mapping: within the CD27+CD11b- compartment, CD27+CD62L- ILC1-like NK cells sorted as single cells "exclusively generated CD62L- clones", stayed phenotypically distinct for >=3 weeks, and under homeostasis showed "no evidence for maturation... into the CD62L+ subsets", whereas CD27+CD62L+ cells did mature to CD27-. Directly refutes the CD27+CD11b- stage being a single obligate precursor. 2) Daussy C, et al. J Exp Med 2014;211:563-577 — PMID 24516120 / PMC3949572 (full text read, archived). From the SAME senior author as the primary (Walzer), revising the 4-stage model: "Id2+ precursors may give rise either to Eomes- NK cells with a CD11b-CD27-/low Trail+/- DX5-/low phenotype or to Eomes+ NK cells. Eomes+ NK cells probably start their maturation process directly as CD11b-CD27+ even though a small fraction of them may go through an earlier CD11b-CD27- stage." 3) Ding Y, et al. Nat Immunol 2024;25:1183-1192 — PMID 38872000 / PMC12338846. Two independent progenitor routes (ENKP vs ILCP) generate transcriptionally and functionally distinct NK populations — two origins, not one linear program. 4) Sojka DK, et al. eLife 2014;3:e01659 — PMID 24714492. Tissue-resident NK cells are lineages distinct from conventional splenic NK cells, so CD27/CD11b staging is not a single organism-wide pathway. 5) Park E, et al. eLife 2019;8 — PMID 31393266. Toxoplasma gondii drives conversion of NK cells into ILC1-like cells: mature NK phenotype is not a terminal one-way endpoint. 6) Vosshenrich CAJ, et al. Nat Immunol 2006;7:1217-1224 — PMID 17013389. Thymic GATA-3+CD127+ NK developmental pathway that does not follow the CD27/CD11b staging.
audit.downstream_dependency: van Helden MJ, et al. "Terminal NK cell maturation is controlled by concerted actions of T-bet and Zeb2 and is essential for melanoma rejection." J Exp Med 2015 (PMID 26503444 / PMC4647267) — the paper's central conclusion is that Zeb2 and T-bet drive the CD27+CD11b+ -> CD27-CD11b+ step; if that step is not a cell-intrinsic conversion, the phenotype is a change in subset composition, not a "maturation block". The same dependency structure is load-bearing for Gordon SM et al. Immunity 2012 (PMID 22261438, "two sequential, genetically separable checkpoints"), Kallies A et al. Blood 2011 (Blimp1), the Bach2 NK-maturation paper (PMC9529614), and essentially the entire mouse NK gene-knockout literature, which scores phenotypes as quadrant-frequency shifts on a CD27 x CD11b plot and reports them as arrest at a stage of this sequence. Translationally, it also underwrites the human CD27/CD11b analogy (Fu B et al. Immunology 2011, PMC3112344) and the use of "CD11b-CD27- NK cells" as a tumour-progression biomarker in lung carcinoma (PMC3614924) and hepatocellular carcinoma (Cell Mol Immunol 2016), where the biomarker's meaning depends entirely on the cells being a defined developmental stage rather than an activation/tissue state.
audit.audit_overturns_detail: The CLASS survives — OBS_TRANSFER is the right bin, and I did not downgrade it. But the initial call's confident word "OBSERVATION" is overturned in three specific ways. (1) EVIDENTIARY BASIS NOT VERIFIABLE: I could not read the methods of either hinted primary. Chiossone 2009 and Hayakawa & Smyth 2006 are both closed-access with Cloudflare 403s on every publisher route, absent from PMC/EuropePMC, and their HAL/IRIS deposits are metadata-only. The statement "adoptive transfer of EGFP+ NK subsets into unirradiated mice" is a DESIGN STATEMENT from the abstract, not methods I read. Per G1 this cannot be scored as a verified observation; the OBS_TRANSFER classification rests on the independently verified transfer methods of Gordon 2012 (PMC3381976) and Flommersfeld 2021 (PMC8528403), not on the primary. (2) BULK, NOT CLONAL: the primary's transfer is a population transfer, which cannot distinguish conversion from selective survival/expansion of a fraction already present in the sort gate. The one study with the resolution to tell these apart shows the gate is heterogeneous: Flommersfeld 2021 found an ILC1-like CD27+CD62L- branch inside the CD27+CD11b- stage that does NOT progress under homeostasis. So the head of the claimed sequence is not a single precursor pool, and the primary's design could not have detected that. (3) REVERSE TRANSITION NOT EXCLUDED: the hint asked whether the reverse transition was excluded. In no text I could read is there a reciprocal transfer of sorted CD27-CD11b+ cells demonstrating they cannot re-acquire CD27; directionality rests on kinetics (INF_KINETIC) and on the terminal subset's low proliferative capacity, not on a demonstrated block. Additionally the claim as written is a 3-stage version that silently drops Chiossone's stage 1 (CD11blowCD27low) — and Chiossone's own senior author reassigned most of that stage-1 population to a separate Eomes- lineage five years later (Daussy 2014). Net: keep OBS_TRANSFER, but the honest reading is "bulk transfer consistent with the ordering, primary methods unread, head-of-sequence gate demonstrably not clonally homogeneous".
audit.methods_quote: VERBATIM FROM METHODS I ACTUALLY READ (the original primary's methods were unobtainable, so no quote from it is offered). (a) Flommersfeld et al., Immunity 2021, PMC8528403, STAR Methods, section "Cell sorting and adoptive transfer of Ly49H+ NK cells" (archived /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_PMC8528403.txt): "For single-cell adoptive transfers CD3-CD19-NK1.1+Ly49H+CD27+ cells harboring distinct color-barcodes were sorted (expression of CD62L and CD11b was indexed or considered for sort decisions where indicated). 15-20 single cells with distinct barcodes were sorted into the same well and transferred into the same host... NK cells were injected i.v. into Rag2-/-Il2rg-/-, Klra8-/- or NKp46iCre x R26-LSL-iDTA recipient mice." (b) Gordon et al., Immunity 2012, PMC3381976, Experimental Procedures/Figure 2 legend: "at least 1x10^4 of the following FACS-purified, medullary NK cell subsets were transferred into immunodeficient recipients: TRAIL+ CD27lowCD11blow, TRAIL+ CD27highCD11blow, DX5+ CD27highCD11blow, and DX5+ CD27high/lowCD11bhigh"; "Indicated organs of recipient mice were harvested after 1w, and donor NK cells were analyzed for expression of Eomes and maturation markers TRAIL, CD27, and CD11b"; recipients were "unirradiated Il2rg-/-Rag2-/- mice"; "Data are representative of 3 experiments." (c) Counter-evidence, Flommersfeld 2021 Results (same archived file): "Importantly, even without MCMV infection, no evidence for maturation of ILC1-like NK cells into the CD62L+ subsets was found, while CD27+CD62L+ NK cells further matured into CD27-CD62L+ cells."

audit.notes: SCOPE MISMATCH WORTH FLAGGING: the claim as written is the 3-stage form (CD27+CD11b- -> CD27+CD11b+ -> CD27-CD11b+), which is the Hayakawa/Smyth framing. The paper that actually established the ordering by transfer is Chiossone 2009, whose model is 4-stage and begins one step earlier at CD11blowCD27low. The claim therefore silently drops the stage whose lineage assignment has since been retracted-in-substance by the same group (Daussy 2014, Walzer lab: that population is largely a separate Eomes- lineage). Auditing the 3-stage form as if it were the published model flatters it. ARCHIVED FILES: /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_16424180.txt, /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_19234143.txt (both abstract-only), /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_PMC3381976.txt, /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_PMC3949572.txt (Daussy 2014, full OA methods), /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_PMC8528403.txt (Flommersfeld 2021, full OA STAR Methods), /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_PMC12338846.txt, /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_40060511.txt. WHY EACH INFERENCE CLASS IS LISTED: INF_MARKER = the entire scheme is a two-colour flow gate on surface density, and Hayakawa & Smyth's human arm is marker overlap only; INF_KINETIC = the DT-depletion repopulation time course and ontogeny orderings; INF_TRAJECTORY = Chiossone's microarray "overall proximity between NK-cell subsets based on their global gene profile" is expression-space adjacency scored as developmental order, which per G2 is the weakest class regardless of framing, and the modern scRNA-seq/Slingshot pseudotime restatements of this scheme (e.g. PMC7255804) are the same class; OBS_GENETIC = T-bet/Eomes/Zeb2/Blimp1/Bach2 knockouts that abolish the CD27-CD11b+ compartment establish necessity of a gene, NOT lineage relationship, and are frequently miscited as if they proved the sequence; OBS_DIRECT = present in the field ONLY via Flommersfeld 2021 single-cell barcoding (a 2021 paper, not the primary), and that same paper is the strongest counter-evidence, so it cannot be used to upgrade the claim without also importing its refutation of gate homogeneity. NOT ASSESSED: I did not obtain per-figure animal counts for Daussy 2014 or Flommersfeld 2021, and I did not attempt to locate a PhD thesis (Chaix/Chiossone) that might restate the Blood 2009 methods - that route was considered and not run.

adv.challenge_reason:
I attacked OBS_TRANSFER and it survives, but only because of an experiment the auditor did not archive properly, and it survives more narrowly than the row claims.

WHAT I RE-CHECKED MYSELF. (1) I re-ran lit.py methods on all three hinted primaries: 19234143 (Chiossone 2009 Blood), 16424180 (Hayakawa & Smyth 2006 J Immunol), 12006976 (Kim 2002 Nat Immunol). All three returned STATUS=ABSTRACT_ONLY, no PMCID. The auditor's paywall finding is CONFIRMED, not an excuse. Per G1 the original primary yields NO methods-verified class at all. (2) PROVENANCE ERROR IN THE ROW: the row cites /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_PMC3381976.txt as the verified basis for OBS_TRANSFER, but that file is 2 lines and its own header reads "# status=ABSTRACT_ONLY pmid=22261438 pmcid=PMC3381976" — it contains PubMed metadata and a reference list, NO methods. The row's verbatim Gordon quote is not traceable to the archive it names. I therefore re-fetched PMC3381976 directly and the quote IS genuine: "at least 1x10^4 of the following FACS-purified subsets were transferred: TRAIL+ CD27lowCD11blow, TRAIL+ CD27highCD11blow, DX5+ CD27highCD11blow, and DX5+ CD27high/lowCD11bhigh"; recipients "unirradiated Il2rg-/-Rag2-/- mice"; "Indicated organs of recipient mice were harvested after 1w, and donor NK cells were analyzed for expression of Eomes and maturation markers TRAIL, CD27, and CD11b"; "Data are representative of 3 experiments." So the class stands on evidence I independently verified, not on the archive the row points to.

WHY NOT DOWNGRADE. A transferred, B recovered, with CD27/CD11b as the read-out, is by definition OBS_TRANSFER. Host lymphopenia is a confound, not a reclassification; downgrading for confounding would be grading quality, not design (G7).

WHY NOT UPGRADE, despite a real OBS_DIRECT experiment the auditor read only half of. The row uses Flommersfeld 2021 exclusively as counter-evidence and omits that the SAME paper contains clone-level support for step 1 of the claim. From the archived text (/home/user/aaa/refs/D2_PMC8528403.txt): "single Ly49H+ NK cells, sorted from the immature CD27+CD11b- compartment, generated both types of response patterns" and "All single-cell-derived clones were uniformly positive for CD11b and Ly49H". Single barcoded cells sorted CD11b-negative yielding uniformly CD11b+ clones is genuine single-cell fate mapping of CD11b acquisition. That is an asymmetric reading by the auditor and should be recorded. It still does not upgrade the strongest class for THIS claim, because (a) it is at day 8 of MCMV infection, i.e. activation-driven, not the steady-state maturation the claim asserts, and (b) its actual content is that CD11b is acquired uniformly REGARDLESS of clonal fate, which supports CD11b being an activation marker rather than a stage counter.

NEW DEFECT THE ROW DOES NOT STATE — STEP 2 IS NOT VERIFIED ON THE CLAIM'S OWN AXIS. The claim has two transitions. Transition 1 (CD27+CD11b- -> CD11b+) is covered by Gordon 2012's verified transfer. Transition 2 (CD27+CD11b+ -> CD27-CD11b+) is NOT covered by any transfer whose methods I could read on the CD11b axis: Gordon transferred a mixed "DX5+ CD27high/lowCD11bhigh" gate and used it as a stability control, not as a step-2 donor; Flommersfeld's homeostatic maturation result is "CD27+CD62L+ NK cells further matured into CD27-CD62L+ cells", which is the CD62L axis used as a proxy. The only claimed step-2 transfer is inside Chiossone 2009, which is unreadable. So OBS_TRANSFER is verified for one of the claim's two transitions and rests on a design statement for the other.

PRIMARY-SOURCE PAPER THE AUDITOR MISSED ENTIRELY: Narni-Mancinelli E et al., PNAS 2011;108:18324-18329, PMID 22021440 / PMC3215049 — genetic fate mapping (Nkp46-iCre x R26R-eYFP) from the SAME lab as Chiossone, whose abstract states it "allowed a reappraisal of the sequential steps of NK cell maturation". This is the closest thing in the field to genetic lineage tracing applied to this staging scheme and it is absent from the row. I obtained the full text (archived /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_PMC3215049_full.txt). Two things matter. First, it does NOT deliver OBS_DIRECT for the claim: eYFP is a stable irreversible timestamp of Nkp46 expression, not a clonal tracer of CD27/CD11b transitions, and their ordering logic is "CD16- cells contain both eYFP- and eYFP+ NK cells in comparable amounts, whereas CD16+ cells are uniformly eYFP+" — that is INF_KINETIC/INF_MARKER reasoning on a lineage-tracing substrate. Second, their Table 1 shows CD27 is NON-MONOTONIC across the six stages: "CD27 - Low + + +/- -". CD27 starts NEGATIVE, rises, then falls, so two different populations in this scheme are CD27-negative and the claim's head state CD27+CD11b- is not the start of the program. Verbatim: "Stage 6 of NK cell maturation is still defined by the disappearance of CD27 in CD11b+ mature NK cells, awaiting the identification of a cell surface molecule that would be selectively and stably induced at this stage." Eleven years after Hayakawa and two years after Chiossone, the originating lab was still describing step 2 as a disappearance of a marker with no stable positive marker to anchor it.

NEGATIVE SEARCH RESULT WORTH RECORDING: I searched for an inducible/timestamp fate map of this sequence ("inducible fate mapping timestamp NK cell maturation CD11b reporter tamoxifen CreERT2 Ncr1") and for CD27 re-expression ("NK cells re-express CD27 upregulation mature NK cells cytokine stimulation reversibility"). Both returned zero hits. So: no ex-CD11b or ex-CD27 reporter has ever been built, and the irreversibility half of the claim has never been tested by the only method that could test it. Searched and none found — not NOT_SEARCHED.
adv.revised_evidence_type_strongest: OBS_TRANSFER — but materially narrower than the row states. Methods-verified (by my own fetch of PMC3381976, not by the archive the row cites) for transition 1 only: in mouse, at least 1x10^4 FACS-purified DX5+CD27highCD11blow and TRAIL+ medullary NK subsets injected into unirradiated Il2rg-/-Rag2-/- recipients, organs harvested at 1 week, donor cells stained for Eomes/TRAIL/CD27/CD11b, "representative of 3 experiments" (n_unit = independent experiments; recipient-animal n not stated). Transition 2 (CD27+CD11b+ -> CD27-CD11b+) has NO methods-verified transfer on the CD11b axis — Flommersfeld's homeostatic result is on CD62L as a proxy, and Chiossone 2009's claimed step-2 transfer is paywall-blocked. Classes also genuinely present: OBS_DIRECT (Flommersfeld 2021 single-cell colour-barcoded clones, but for infection-driven CD11b acquisition, not steady-state staging); OBS_GENETIC (T-bet/Eomes/Zeb2/Blimp1 knockouts = gene necessity, not lineage); INF_KINETIC (DT-depletion repopulation kinetics; the eYFP-timestamp ordering in Narni-Mancinelli 2011); INF_MARKER (the whole scheme is a two-colour surface-density gate); INF_TRAJECTORY (Chiossone's microarray "overall proximity ... based on global gene profile", plus modern scRNA-seq/velocity restatements — G2, weakest, regardless of framing).
adv.new_counter_evidence:
THE BIG ONE THE AUDITOR MISSED — the transfer artefact demonstrated in NK cells themselves. Kamimura Y & Lanier LL. "Homeostatic control of memory cell progenitors in the natural killer cell lineage." Cell Rep 2015;10(2):280-291. PMID 25578733 / PMC4359047. Full text read. This paper does not appear anywhere in the row's counter_evidence or searches_run. Its design is the direct control that every transfer supporting D2 lacks: KLRG1-negative WT CD45.1+ NK cells were transferred into lymphopenic Rag1-/- or Tcra-/- hosts versus WT hosts. In the T-cell-deficient recipients donor NK cells underwent homeostatic proliferation and showed a dramatic increase in the percentage of KLRG1int+ NK cells relative to WT recipients; depleting commensals with antibiotics in Rag1-/- hosts reduced both the KLRG1int+ frequency and the homeostatic proliferation. IL-15 drove KLRG1 dose-dependently in vitro and adding T cells suppressed it; Il15+/- mice had fewer KLRG1+ NK cells and Il15-/- essentially none. The authors' framing is competition for IL-15. KLRG1 is co-acquired with CD11b at stages 5-6 of this very scheme (Narni-Mancinelli 2011 Table 1: KLRG1 Low at stage 5, + at stage 6). So the terminal-maturation phenotype is set by how much unconsumed IL-15 the host has. Now look at the hosts in every transfer that survives G1 in this row: Gordon 2012 used Il2rg-/-Rag2-/- (no T, no B, no NK, and no cell able to consume IL-15 via the common gamma chain); Flommersfeld 2021 used Rag2-/-Il2rg-/-, Klra8-/-, or NKp46iCre x R26-LSL-iDTA. Every one is an NK-empty, IL-15-replete niche. Kamimura & Lanier show that is precisely the condition that manufactures the mature phenotype. This is not a hypothetical confound; it is a published, in-NK-cells demonstration, and the row's OBS_TRANSFER evidence is measured under it. It also compounds Soderquest 2011 (PMID 21389319), which the row cites only as a secondary aside: CD11b acquisition is monocyte- and IL-15-dependent, so the read-out marker and the confound are the same variable. Note for completeness: Kamimura & Lanier found NO evidence of KLRG1+ cells reverting, so it does not support reversibility — it attacks the directional-conversion inference from the donor side, not the terminal-state side.

SECOND MISSED PAPER, same-lab and lineage-tracing based. Narni-Mancinelli E et al., PNAS 2011;108:18324-18329, PMID 22021440 / PMC3215049 (full text archived at /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_PMC3215049_full.txt). Nkp46-iCre x R26R-eYFP genetic fate mapping from the Vivier/Walzer lab. Its Table 1 makes CD27 non-monotonic across the scheme (- / Low / + / + / +/- / -), so the claim's head state is not the start of the program and CD27-negativity is not a unique coordinate. And the paper concedes step 2 has no stable positive marker: "Stage 6 of NK cell maturation is still defined by the disappearance of CD27 in CD11b+ mature NK cells, awaiting the identification of a cell surface molecule that would be selectively and stably induced at this stage." A transition defined only by loss of a marker is exactly the kind that selection/differential-survival mimics perfectly.

THIRD: an internal inconsistency in the row's own strongest counter-source. The auditor presents Flommersfeld 2021 as pure refutation. Its clone-level data also CONFIRM CD11b acquisition ("All single-cell-derived clones were uniformly positive for CD11b"), which the row omits. Reporting only the refuting half is the same selective-reading failure the audit is meant to catch, and I record it against the auditor rather than against the claim.

The row's existing counter-evidence (Flommersfeld 2021 PMID 34437840; Daussy 2014 PMID 24516120; Ding 2024 PMID 38872000; Sojka 2014 PMID 24714492; Park 2019 PMID 31393266; Vosshenrich 2006 PMID 17013389) all check out and I do not dispute it.

SEARCHED, NOTHING FOUND (recording as searched, not as absent): three NCBI PMC full-text boolean searches for the selection-not-conversion alternative stated in those words — '"CD27" AND "CD11b" AND "NK" AND ("selective expansion" OR "selectively expanded" OR "not conversion" OR "preferential survival")' (144 hits), '"NK cell" AND "CD27" AND "CD11b" AND ("independent lineages" OR "separate lineages" OR "distinct lineages") AND "maturation"' (63 hits), '"CD11b" AND "NK" AND ("upregulated upon activation" OR "activation-induced CD11b")' (67 hits). None of the returned records is a paper that sets out to test selection versus conversion for the CD27/CD11b sequence. No failed replication of Chiossone 2009 exists that I could find. The absence of a direct refutation is not support: nobody has run the experiment that could refute it.
adv.crossfield_g4_findings:
The claim borrows a completely generic process — a surface-marker-defined linear differentiation series, inferred from bulk adoptive transfer into an emptied niche. Both of its markers, and both of its inferential moves, have known fatal collisions in the fields they came from. The row ran no cross-field search at all.

1. MYELOID FIELD — CD11b/Mac-1 is an activation readout, not a clock. Miller LJ, Bainton DF, Borregaard N, Springer TA, J Clin Invest 1987;80:535-544, PMID 3038962: Mac-1 (CD11b/CD18) and p150,95 are stored in an intracellular vesicular compartment and mobilized to the cell surface on stimulation. In the field that discovered this molecule, CD11b surface density is a minutes-scale degranulation readout. A "CD11b-low to CD11b-high" transition therefore requires no differentiation whatsoever, and is inducible by handling, temperature, chemoattractant, or cytokine during the tissue prep and stain. That is the x-axis of the plot on which this entire claim is drawn, and it is a translocation assay in its home field. It also explains Flommersfeld's result that ALL infection-driven clones went CD11b+ regardless of fate.

2. MYELOID FIELD — the exactly homologous claim was overturned, by exactly the method never applied here. "Blood monocytes become tissue macrophages" was held for decades on marker overlap plus transfer into irradiated/lymphopenic recipients — the same evidence structure as D2. Genetic fate mapping and parabiosis destroyed it: Schulz C et al., Science 2012;336:86-90, PMID 22442384 (a Myb-independent lineage of macrophages arising independently of HSCs); Gomez Perdiguero E et al., Nature 2015;518:547-551, PMID 25470051 (tissue-resident macrophages from yolk-sac erythro-myeloid progenitors). The transfers had "worked" precisely BECAUSE the niche had been emptied. The control case is just as instructive: Yona S et al., Immunity 2013;38:79-91, PMID 23273845 confirmed the Ly6Chi -> Ly6Clo monocyte conversion, but only with an inducible Cx3cr1-CreER timestamp in an intact animal — not by transfer. That is the standard of proof D2 has never met, and my search for an equivalent inducible NK timestamp returned zero.

3. T CELL FIELD — transfer into a lymphopenic host manufactures the "mature" phenotype. Cho BK, Rao VP, Ge Q, Eisen HN, Chen J, J Exp Med 2000;192:549-556, PMID 10952724, "Homeostasis-stimulated proliferation drives naive T cells to differentiate directly into memory T cells": naive T cells transferred into a lymphopenic host convert to a memory surface phenotype through homeostatic proliferation alone, with no antigen and no genuine memory differentiation. This has been standard knowledge since 2000. Every transfer in this row whose methods survive G1 uses an Il2rg-/-Rag2-/- or NK-ablated host. The NK field then independently rediscovered the same artefact without connecting it to the staging model (Kamimura & Lanier 2015, PMID 25578733, above). The T cell field's fix was congenic transfer into intact hosts or in-situ fate mapping; Chiossone's unirradiated-host design is the one experiment in this literature that would have addressed it, and it is the one nobody can read.

4. T CELL FIELD — CD27 indexes stimulation history, not developmental age. CD27 is a TNFRSF costimulatory receptor whose surface level is governed by engagement with CD70 and which is shed as soluble CD27; Hendriks J et al., Nat Immunol 2000;1:433-440, PMID 11062504 established CD27/CD70 as the axis controlling T cell expansion and maintenance. In T cell immunology "CD27-low" is read as cumulative antigen/CD70 exposure, which is why CD27 loss is not monotonic with time and is reversed or prevented by altering CD70 availability. Importing CD27 into NK cells as a maturation clock imports a molecule that its home field reads as a ligand-driven state variable. This dovetails with Narni-Mancinelli's non-monotonic CD27 column and with the fact that step 2 of D2 is defined purely as loss of this molecule.

5. T CELL FIELD — "terminally differentiated" surface phenotypes are not terminal, and only an ex-marker fate map can see it. Herndler-Brandstetter D et al., Immunity 2018;48:716-729, PMID 29625895: "Using genetic fate mapping analysis of highly cytotoxic KLRG1+ effector CD8+ T cells, we demonstrated that KLRG1+ cells ... downregulated KLRG1 during the contraction phase in a Bach2-dependent manner and differentiated into all memory T cell lineages", generating "ExKLRG1" memory cells. The canonical terminal marker was reversible, and it took a KLRG1 fate-mapping reporter to find out — no transfer or kinetic study had. D2 asserts CD27-CD11b+ is the endpoint of a one-way sequence. No ex-CD11b or ex-CD27 NK reporter exists (searched, zero hits), so the terminal and directional half of D2 sits in exactly the blind spot that hid ExKLRG1 for fifteen years. Note KLRG1 is itself part of this very NK staging scheme.

6. T CELL FIELD — bulk ordering is not any individual cell's trajectory. Buchholz VR et al., Science 2013;340:630-635, PMID 23493420 ("Disparate individual fates compose robust CD8+ T cell immunity") and Gerlach C et al., Science 2013;340:635-639, PMID 23493421 ("Heterogeneous differentiation patterns of individual CD8+ T cells"): single-cell fate mapping showed that a smooth, reproducible population-level differentiation series is assembled from wildly heterogeneous single-cell fates, and that the population average corresponds to no actual cell. This is the formal reason a bulk CD27/CD11b transfer cannot license "A becomes B". Flommersfeld 2021 is the NK field's late arrival at this same result and it found the same thing — a heterogeneous head gate.

7. ILC FIELD — marker transitions of exactly this kind are cytokine rheostats, and IL-15 is the knob. Vonarbourg C et al., Immunity 2010;33:736-751, PMID 21093318: using adoptive transfer of genetically tagged LTi-like cells plus genetic lineage tracing, differentiation was "characterized by the stable upregulation of NKRs and a progressive loss of RORgt expression", and critically "IL-7 and intestinal microbiota stabilized RORgt expression within such NKR-LTi cells, IL-12 and IL-15 accelerated RORgt loss"; the authors call the marker gradient "a tunable rheostat for their functional program", not a developmental stage. Two direct consequences for D2. First, a marker-loss transition whose rate is set by IL-15 is precisely what D2's step 2 looks like, and the NK transfers were done in IL-15-flooded hosts. Second, this lineage ends up NK1.1+NKR+ and phenocopies NK cells — a marker-defined endpoint reached from an unrelated lineage, so occupancy of the CD27-CD11b+ gate does not identify a cell's history. The field's own caveat literature agrees (PMID 36052086, "Just one word, plastic!": most ILC plasticity and maturation claims rest on in vitro culture and transfer into alymphoid hosts and are not established in situ).

NET: the myeloid field says the x-axis marker is a degranulation assay; the T cell field says the y-axis marker is a ligand-exposure assay; the T cell field says the transfer design manufactures the phenotype; the myeloid field says this exact evidence structure produced a famous wrong answer; the T cell field says bulk ordering is not a trajectory; and the ILC field says marker-loss transitions of this shape are IL-15-tunable rheostats. None of this is visible from NK keywords, and none of it is in the row.

adv.load_bearing_reason:
I tried to argue the auditor was being generous and failed. The steelman for downgrading to MEDIUM is that most of the mouse NK knockout literature only needs CD27 x CD11b as a phenotypic severity index: if the sequence collapses, "Zeb2-deficient NK cells fail to occupy the CD27-CD11b+ quadrant" is still a true measurement, merely relabelled from "maturation arrest" to "composition shift". Data survive, wording changes. That argument fails for a specific reason — the load-bearing dependencies are not the quadrant measurements, they are causal and therapeutic conclusions built on the quadrant being a developmental endpoint.

CONCRETE NAMED DEPENDENCY 1 (verified by NCBI esummary, PMID 26503444): van Helden MJ, Goossens S, Daussy C, Mathieu A-L, et al. "Terminal NK cell maturation is controlled by concerted actions of T-bet and Zeb2 and is essential for melanoma rejection." J Exp Med 2015 Nov 16. The title is a two-link causal chain — Zeb2/T-bet cause terminal maturation, terminal maturation causes melanoma rejection. Both links require CD27-CD11b+ to be a cell-intrinsic developmental endpoint. If, per Kamimura & Lanier 2015 (PMID 25578733) and Soderquest 2011 (PMID 21389319), that phenotype is an IL-15/monocyte-set activation state, the conclusion does not merely get reworded: "drive terminal maturation to reject melanoma" becomes "drive IL-15 signalling", which is a different intervention with a different dose-response and, per Kamimura & Lanier's own conclusion, an opposing cost — excessive IL-15 erodes the memory-progenitor pool. Note the author overlap with the primary's lab (Daussy, Walzer), so this is the originating group's own therapeutic conclusion resting on its own staging model.

CONCRETE NAMED DEPENDENCY 2 (translational, and the sharpest one): IL-15 superagonist dosing in NK-cell therapy. Kamimura & Lanier 2015 explicitly frames its finding as IL-15 availability eroding memory progenitors by pushing NK cells along this maturation axis. That inference — and the clinical caution it generates for IL-15 agonist regimens paired with adoptive NK products — is only meaningful if KLRG1/CD11b acquisition marks an irreversible position on a developmental sequence rather than a reversible activation state. Herndler-Brandstetter 2018 (PMID 29625895) shows how badly that assumption can fail in the sister lineage: KLRG1+ CD8 T cells assumed terminal turned out to seed all memory lineages. Nobody has run the ex-CD11b/ex-CD27 NK experiment (searched, zero hits), so this dosing rationale is unfalsified rather than validated.

CONCRETE NAMED DEPENDENCY 3: Gordon SM et al., Immunity 2012, PMID 22261438, concludes for "two sequential, genetically separable checkpoints of NK cell maturation". The word sequential is the claim. Its transfer was into unirradiated Il2rg-/-Rag2-/- hosts, i.e. the IL-15-replete niche Kamimura & Lanier later showed forces the mature phenotype — so this dependency is not merely downstream of D2, it inherits D2's confound. The row's other named dependants (Kallies 2011 Blood, Blimp1; the Bach2 NK paper PMC9529614) are of the same form.

The row's biomarker dependencies (CD11b-CD27- NK cells as a tumour-progression biomarker in lung carcinoma and HCC; the human CD56bright/CD56dim analogy) I also checked and they are real but weaker, since a biomarker can be predictive without its developmental interpretation being correct. I would not have led with them. Dependencies 1 and 2 alone carry HIGH.
adv.better_primary_source: NONE — the auditor identified the correct primary. Chiossone L et al., Blood 2009;113:5488-5496, PMID 19234143, DOI 10.1182/blood-2008-10-187179 is genuinely the first paper to establish the full ordered sequence by transfer, and I independently reconfirmed it is paywalled with no PMCID (lit.py returns STATUS=ABSTRACT_ONLY). Kim S et al., Nat Immunol 2002, PMID 12006976, is the true earliest primary for the CD11b-low -> CD11b-high arm alone (MeSH carries Adoptive Transfer + Macrophage-1 Antigen and no CD27), and Hayakawa Y & Smyth MJ, J Immunol 2006, PMID 16424180, is the earliest for the CD27 subsetting alone — both correctly identified in the row. TWO PAPERS THE ROW SHOULD HAVE CONTAINED BUT DID NOT, neither of which displaces Chiossone as primary: (a) Narni-Mancinelli E et al., PNAS 2011;108:18324-18329, PMID 22021440 / PMC3215049 — the same lab's genetic fate-mapping follow-up that explicitly "allowed a reappraisal of the sequential steps of NK cell maturation", makes CD27 non-monotonic across the scheme, and concedes step 2 still lacks any stable positive marker; full text obtained and archived at /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_PMC3215049_full.txt. (b) Kamimura Y & Lanier LL, Cell Rep 2015;10:280-291, PMID 25578733 / PMC4359047 — the in-NK-cell demonstration that transfer into a lymphopenic, IL-15-replete host itself drives the terminal-maturation phenotype, which is the missing control for every methods-verified transfer in this row. Also flagging a provenance defect rather than a sourcing one: the row cites /home/user/aaa/refs/D2_PMC3381976.txt as its verified basis for OBS_TRANSFER, but that file self-reports status=ABSTRACT_ONLY and contains no methods; I re-fetched PMC3381976 myself and confirmed the quoted text is accurate, so the classification stands, but the row's audit trail does not support it as written.
